summary: Backend-only testing of AutoPricePro FastAPI. 23/23 pytest cases passed against the public preview URL. Covered: JWT auth (register/login/me), seeded vehicle DB (makes/models/derivatives), dealer submission with 5 base64 photos, admin listing + pricing (verified non-blocking behavior with placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY -> 200 OK), admin dealer management with submission_count and cascade delete, and RBAC (dealer denied 403 on all /api/admin/* endpoints, missing/invalid JWT -> 401). Verified no MongoDB _id or password_hash leaks across auth, submissions, and dealer endpoints. No fixes were required.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 488 lines is under the 700-line split threshold but growing; consider modularising auth/vehicles/submissions/admin into routers before adding more features.
Deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup')/'shutdown' handlers are used; migrate to lifespan context (FastAPI >=0.109 deprecation) to future-proof.
Pydantic v1-style .dict() is called on DealerInfo/CompanyInfo (lines 171-172, 183-184); prefer .model_dump() if Pydantic v2 is in use.
Submissions store full base64 photos (5 images) directly in MongoDB documents which can exceed the 16MB BSON limit at high resolution; consider GridFS or object storage.
JWT_SECRET falls back to 'dev_secret' if unset; require it via os.environ[...] (fail fast) similar to MONGO_URL to prevent silent insecure prod deploys.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral dealers with unique emails (TEST_ prefix on company_name). One dealer is deleted via the admin delete endpoint; the primary session dealer remains but is uniquely suffixed per run so it does not pollute future test runs (though DB will accumulate over iterations).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Use /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py as regression suite. Admin creds: admin@autopricepro.com / admin123 (seeded on startup). All /api/admin/* require Bearer JWT with role=admin; dealers get 403. EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is placeholder and confirmed non-blocking on pricing endpoint. Base URL: https://auto-price-pro-1.preview.emergentagent.com.
